parameters.content:
**SJF AI Telecaller (call finished, notes and follow-up)**

WHAT IT DOES: when the ElevenLabs AI telecaller finishes a call, this flow reads the call report, Grok writes a short summary and score, a row goes on the Monday SJF Ticket Desk board and a follow-up task is added under it for a person.

TRIGGER: ElevenLabs post-call report sent to the address 'sjf-call-finished' (secret header X-SJF-Key).

WHAT A PERSON APPROVES: the follow-up task. The flow never calls or messages anybody.

BEFORE SWITCHING ON: set the ElevenLabs post-call webhook to this address; check the field names (name, company, transcript) match what ElevenLabs sends.
